text:
zoe (AE): Kickoff: Meridian wants Veridian->Redwood migration POC. Goals: minimal SDK changes, prompt parity, billing clarity, security packet.

omar (SE): Need their SDK request samples, 15-25 prompts, expected outputs for critical prompts, and traffic profile (peak qps, avg tokens).

felix (Solutions Eng): I'll run parity checks: exact-match for templates, token-distribution diffs for open prompts, and a small human check on safety-sensitive prompts. Deliverable: 1-pager + 5 failure examples. ETA 48h after inputs.

jamie (Infra): For POC we'll offer a compatibility route. Need test CIDR and whether they require mTLS. Will provision POC key once CIDR provided.

mira (Security): Send vendor questionnaire; I'll pre-fill controls. Highlights: SOC2, KMS, TLS, audit logs, SSO. Ask them to call out any regs (HIPAA/GDPR).

zoe (AE): They hit an issue previously where small formatting diffs broke downstream parsers. Can we provide a strict-json output option?

felix (Solutions Eng): Yes — shim will support header X-Redwood-Mode: strict-json and return parsed_output + validation_errors. We'll include a schema example.

quotes-bot: POC keys default limits: 60 rps, 200k tokens/day. Request quota bump with billing.

omar (SE): Also recommend a fuzz-run that mutates whitespace/punctuation to reveal brittle regexes. I'll add it to the harness.

jamie (Infra): Quick curl example for QA: curl -X POST https://poc.redwood.test/compat/veridian -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1"}],"max_tokens":150}' Response maps to their expected fields.

zoe (AE): Timeline: customer wants demo + parity report in 5 business days. Can we do that?

felix (Solutions Eng): If assets arrive in 24h, yes.

zoe (AE): I'll request assets and CIDR now and loop Legal and Billing. Keeping thread as canonical presales coordination.
